page.overview:
What is Harry Potter Anniversary Lines?

Harry Potter Anniversary Lines is a sub-theme of Harry Potter introduced in 2021 to celebrate the anniversary of 20 Years of LEGO Harry Potter. Each set in the LEGO Harry Potter 20 Years line came with at least one special edition golden minifigure.
